I farm a small sorghum plot with my family, and because the land is mine and mixed with other crops, I will manage it in a simple way that fits what I can afford and the work we can do ourselves. I do not have much money for expensive inputs or irrigation, so I will rely more on family labor, some manure if I can get it, and the seed I know well. I may use a little chemical spray for weeds or pests if needed, but not much else.
